page.layout: One column of text with a running head at top. Years stand in a left column beside groups of names, separated by rules. Below the last line: signature at left, catchword at right.; One printed page, part 2 of 2 (the rest is cut off). Page number at top right. Main text area blank or cut off. A narrow column of two marginal notes at lower left, outside the text block.

marginalia.note: ULRICUS GRETHANUS in ordinem Co-mitum promo-tus nescio populo.

note.i: Fœdus civitati renovatum ordini-bus agri vicini.

page.notes: The catchword "Henrick" and the signature "V 4" are printed on this part and are therefore included, although the instructions said none would appear here. "Hanzow" in the 1454 line is a doubtful reading. The "Gosen" spellings use plain s for the long s. The main text block is not visible on this part of the scan, so the two marginal notes have no running text beside them. "Fœdus" is read as printed; the ligature could not be fully confirmed. The superscript after "COMITUM" was not clearly legible and is read as "COMITUM" with no mark.
